record.summary: Cross-sectoral companion profile to the AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) for generative AI, prepared under Executive Order 14110. It defines twelve risks that are novel to or exacerbated by generative AI, among them CBRN information or capabilities, confabulation, dangerous or violent content, harmful bias, information integrity, information security and intellectual property, and sets out suggested actions to govern, map, measure and manage them.
